meta.description: Every citizen-facing string in MTHANDIZI. No hardcoded strings anywhere else in the app.
meta.orthography: Standard Malawian Chichewa. Differs from Zambian Nyanja spelling in places.
meta.review_status: UNREVIEWED — no entry in this file has been approved by a native speaker yet

greeting_idle.chi: Moni. Ndine Mthandizi. Ndingakuthandizeni bwanji lero?
greeting_idle.en: Hello. I am Mthandizi. How can I help you today?

intent_confirm.note: Dynamic — {service} substituted from lexicon.services at runtime. Cannot be pre-recorded whole.

intent_clarify.note: Dynamic conversational clarification for two likely intents; never rendered as a menu.

intent_explain_again.chi: Pepani, sindinamve bwino. Mungandiuze m'mawu anu zomwe mukufuna?
intent_explain_again.en: Sorry, I didn't understand. Can you tell me in your own words what you need?
intent_explain_again.note: Dynamic clarification prompt, reused for the final open explanation attempt.

intent_fallback.chi: Pepani, sindinamve bwino. Chonde pemphani thandizo kwa munthu amene akugwira ntchito pano.
intent_fallback.en: Sorry, I didn't understand. Please ask a staff member for help.
intent_fallback.note: Human assistance fallback after clarification attempts.

ask_child_dob.chi: Mwana anabadwa liti? Nenani tsiku, mwezi, ndi chaka.
ask_child_dob.en: When was the child born? Say the day, month, and year.

ask_mother_name.chi: Dzina la amayi a mwana ndi ndani?

ask_father_name.chi: Kodi mukufuna kuika dzina la abambo a mwana? Mungasiye ngati mukufuna.
ask_father_name.en: Would you like to add the father's name? You may skip this.

ask_reason_visit.en: What is wrong? Tell me briefly.

ask_contact_phone.chi: Muli ndi nambala ya foni? Mungasiye ngati mulibe.
ask_contact_phone.en: Do you have a phone number? You may skip if not.

ask_id_reason.chi: Kodi mukufuna chiphaso chatsopano, kapena chanu chataika kapena chawonongeka?
ask_id_reason.en: Do you need a new ID, or is yours lost or damaged?

ask_doc_type.chi: Mukufuna pasipoti yatsopano kapena kukonzanso yakale?
ask_doc_type.en: New passport or renewing an old one?

ask_travel_purpose.en: What is the purpose of your travel?

review_intro.chi: Tiyeni tiwone zonse zimene mwandiuzani. Ndidzawerenga, mundiuze ngati zonse ndi zolondola.
review_intro.en: Let's review everything you've told me. I'll read it back — tell me if it's all correct.

ask_which_field_to_fix.en: What would you like to fix?

completion.chi: Zatha. Nambala yanu ndi {reference}. Iyi si chikalata chovomerezeka — ndi pempho lokonzeka loti liwunikidwe ndi wogwira ntchito.
completion.en: Done. Your reference number is {reference}. This is not an issued document — it is a prepared application awaiting officer verification.

reask_1.en: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Please say it again.

reask_2_with_example.en: Say it again, more slowly. For example: {example}.

reask_3_escalate_touch.chi: Sindikumva bwino. Chonde pemphani thandizo kwa wogwira ntchito.
reask_3_escalate_touch.en: I'm having trouble hearing you. Please ask a staff member for help.
reask_3_escalate_touch.note: Human assistance fallback; no service menu is offered.

disclaimer_not_official.chi: Chidziwitso: Ichi ndi chitsanzo chosonyeza momwe zingagwirire ntchito. Sichikalata chovomerezeka ndi boma.
disclaimer_not_official.en: Notice: this is a prototype demonstration. It is not an official government-issued document.

no_camera.chi: Kamera sikupezeka. Gwiritsani ntchito chala pa siketini kuti muyambe.
no_camera.en: No camera detected. Use touch to begin.

mic_denied.chi: Sitikupeza mawu anu. Gwiritsani ntchito siketini.
mic_denied.en: We can't hear you. Please use the touch screen.

service_unreachable.en: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.

sync_failed.chi: Zosungidwa mwa ino sizinatumizidwe pakadali pano. Zidzatumizidwa pamene network ipezeka.
sync_failed.en: This record hasn't synced yet. It will send automatically when a connection is available.

lexicon.note_districts: First-draft list, not verified against an official gazetteer. Validate before deployment.
